notes.title: Fragile Reflection 1.0.3 hotfix
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there!

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the last platform in the Gong puzzle area.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would not load the latest save in the second part of the city area.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Kario would not appear in the first dialogue with Haruki.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the incorrect speaker in the final library dialogue.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with overlapping text occurring in the security room note.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed slopes that allowed players to skip the main city puzzles.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the hints for the stairs.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the backdoor of the swimming pool more obvious for players to find.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Jinsei achievement.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issues (We’re Working On):[/b][/p][list][*][p]Long loading and saving times.[/p][/*][*][p]The game "forgets" about having melee equipped (occurs only after restarting the level).[/p][/*][*][p]Minor character model bugs during the library dialogue.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Closing:[/b][/p][p]Thanks for your feedback. See you in the next patch![/p]

notes.title: Fragile Reflection 1.0.2 patch
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there!

Thanks for your feedback regarding bugs and requests to add some additional stuff into the game!
We read every review and post in Fragile Reflection Steam community.

Here's patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Added nausea-issue resolving methods: FOV slider and additional effects to turn off (see VHS toggle).[/p][/*][*][p]Added hit reaction for the player. Special animation plays when Kario takes damage. It prevents her from using some weapons for the short period, but she still can move;[/p][/*][*][p]Sounds sliders mistake resolved: no 0 (mute) - 1 (max) levels of sound corellate to the settings;[/p][/*][*][p]Y-Inversion for the camera has been added;[/p][/*][*][p]Sensitivity default value is now correct;[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved the menu navigation issue;[/p][/*][*][p]Incorrect hint glyphs bug fixed;[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies timings got adjusted;[/p][/*][*][p]Added more ammo on the boss arenas;[/p][/*][*][p]Sanatorium section texture clipping bug resolved;[/p][/*][*][p]City section river hatch stuck resolved;[/p][/*][*][p]Pool-rooms falling bug resolved;[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected character's name on the first dialogue with Haruki.[/p][/*][/list][p]Issues that we aware of and working on:[/p][list][*][p]Long loading/saving problem;[/p][/*][*][p]Game "forgets" about having melee equipped (occurs only after restarting the level)[/p][/*][*][p]Jinsei achievment problem  [/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for your feedback, see you next patch![/p]

notes.title: Fragile Reflection 1.0.1 patch
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there!

We've received some feedback regarding some types of enemies being too unfair and hard to counter-play. 
Also, melee-combat was not strong enough to be used in combat.[/p][list][*][p]Enemies difficulty has been adjusted (including annoying spider behaviour, overall timings)[/p][/*][*][p]Player's speed has been adjusted[/p][/*][*][p]Low-health audio play chance has been decreased[/p][/*][*][p]City level bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Sanatorium level - added hints after solving the Projector puzzle[/p][/*][*][p]Increased camera FOV[/p][/*][/list][p]We are very thankful for your feedback!

Some issues we are aware and working on right now:[/p][list][*][p]Incorrect Gamepad Hints[/p][/*][*][p]Nausea issue[/p][/*][*][p]Request to add Axis inversion[/p][/*][*][p]Default Sensitivity[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing other bugs[/p][/*][/list]
